notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]Bee Simulator: The Hive[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]


🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

notes.title: 🐝 Bee Simulator makes a buzz at Expo2Bee 🐝
notes.content:
Hey bee-lievers! We’ve got some un-bee-lievable news for you! 🐝✨  
Bee Simulator and its upcoming expansion, The Hive. are making a [i]bee-line[/i] to [b]Expo2Bee[/b], the [b]1st Polish National Beekeeping Expo[/b] happening at [b]Targi Kielce, April 26-27, 2025[/b] — and guess what? [b]Today’s the first day![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33329465/0a4d944c9330b434f0815703f53c529d2613f1e9.png[/img]

Expo2Bee is the first event of its kind, bringing together beekeepers, beenthusiasts, and industry experts from around Poland. We couldn’t miss the chance for real bees and their digital sisters to finally meet! There are signs of what’s coming for you to look for, so if you spot any, take a pic and share it with #expo2bee and #beesimulator hashtags. 🍯

[hr][/hr]

🎮 [b]About Expo2Bee[/b]  
Dive into the sweet world of beekeeping at Expo2Bee! This 1st Polish National Beekeeping Expo buzzes with the latest in apiculture, from cutting-edge equipment to the wonders of apitherapy. Whether you're a seasoned beekeeper or just starting your honeyed journey, a hive of knowledge and products awaits you. Explore the health benefits of bee products in medicine, cosmetics, and wellness. It's the perfect place to connect with fellow enthusiasts and industry experts.

🌐:[url=https://www.targikielce.pl/expo2bee]Website[/url]
📘[url=https://www.facebook.com/expo2bee/](https://www.facebook.com/expo2bee/]Facebook[/url]

🎮 [b]About Bee Simulator: The Hive[/b]  
Live the epic adventure of a tiny bee in a vast world! Collect pollen, race through jet streams, and protect your hive from wasps. Now, even bigger with The Hive expansion, gather resources and build and customize your very own beehive!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348910/Bee_Simulator_The_Hive/

🎮 [b]About Bee Simulator[/b]  
Live the big adventure of a small bee! Explore a world brimming with life in which you collect pollen, defy dangerous wasps and save your hive! Play with others in three game modes, including four players co-op and PvP on split screen.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914750/Bee_Simulator/

[hr][/hr]

💛 Stay tuned for more updates as the weekend unfolds — and don’t forget to share your photos from the event using [b]#Expo2Bee[/b] and [b]#BeeSimulator[/b]! 🧡 Bee there or bee square!
